contact_edits.before: I wouldn't want Soulpepper to embark on a Simon cycle; the appeal of this show has much to do with seeing this company's two signature actors in joyous partnership. But everything else backs them up, down to the inspired choices of music between scenes and even at the curtain call. You laugh, and you enjoy it. - The Odd Couple plays in repertory at Toronto's Young Centre for the Performing Arts until April 19. Call 416-866-8666 for information.
